snapshot.title: Company snapshot
body: Radarscape Mozambique Limitada is a Mozambican engineering, construction and infrastructure delivery company serving clients in Oil & Gas, energy, industrial and strategic infrastructure environments. We deliver practical, execution-focused solutions that help clients complete critical projects safely, on time and with strong commercial control.

Established in September 2021 and operational since 2022, the company has rapidly built a credible execution presence in Cabo Delgado, with experience in demanding project environments linked to the TotalEnergies Mozambique LNG Area 1 ecosystem. This gives Radarscape relevant exposure to the standards, responsiveness and delivery discipline expected on high-specification projects.

Radarscape combines local market access, execution agility and group-backed technical depth. Supported by its parent group, Macefield Ventures Mozambique Limitada, and affiliated expertise from established regional businesses, the company gives clients a strong combination of local participation, scalable delivery capability and international project standards.
